Need to gain presidency? Holder is 2 with influence 1. I have influence 1, tie order 2>1>0, so 2 wins ties. To become president need influence 2+. Bribing 5 to idx0 (influence 2) — no, bribe gives me influence floor(amount/5M). Bribing 5M gives me 2 influence > others (2 has 1, 0 has 2)... idx0 has influence 2. So need 3 influence to be top: 10M bribe. That makes me president in law phase, plus 5% bank bonus at end for max influence? Only I'd have 3 vs 2. Cash cost 10M vs control of law and veto. Bank is 30M, 5% = 1.5M. Value of presidency with veto... but bribe money goes to rival, increasing their rank. Hmm.

Alternative: shuttle gives 3 goods to sell. Also round 4 has license auction — cash is useful for bidding.

Influence also matters for final 5% bonus (1.5M). Spending 10M to give rival 10M — bad. Perhaps just shuttle for goods.
